evidence.observation: Before growth, O2 was 7.9 ppm and pressure 3.024 Torr at Ar 99.8 sccm.
During growth, O2 increased to 10.1 ppm and pressure to 3.072 Torr.
O2 continued rising to 18.2 ppm and pressure to 3.135 Torr.
O2 reached 24.3 ppm and pressure 3.212 Torr despite Ar at 99.9 sccm and temperature at the 750.0 C setpoint; the sustained gas-side trend suggests an execution anomaly.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust-conductance check, plus expected growth-stage pressure/O2 ranges, are needed to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction or growth-related gas release; sample characterization is not yet available.
